title.zh: 划定保和省第一公路工程区属地管辖范围的法案
title.en: An Act Defining the Territorial Jurisdiction of the First Highway Engineering District in the Province of Bohol.
title.orig: An Act Defining the Territorial Jurisdiction of the First Highway Engineering District in the Province of Bohol.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1971/ra_6311_1971.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The First Highway Engineering District in the Province of Bohol shall comprise the Municipalities of Calape, Loon, Maribojoc, Antequera, Cortes, Corella, Baclayon, Dauis and Panglao with principal station in the Municipality of Loon.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 19, 1971
